name: 文件助手
description: Import authorized local files, search archived files, and organize them with evidence-based classification.
description_zh: 连接文件助手，导入已授权目录文件并进行检索、归档、查重和分类。
description_en: Connect to local File Agent for authorized file import, search, duplicate review, archival and classification.
examples_zh: 请用文件助手归档受管目录中的奖学金申请材料并按内容分类
请用文件助手找出 2025 年奖学金申请相关的文件，并说明依据
请用文件助手读取刚刚检索到的 Excel 文件并总结各工作表
examples_en: Archive authorized scholarship application files and classify them by content
Find scholarship application files from 2025 and explain the evidence
Read the Excel file found in this conversation and summarize its worksheets
